content:
Hi Everyone,
I’m Ravish, one of the co-founders of Opoch Inc.

For the last 13 months, we’ve been working on a single axiom mathematical framework. After few retries, we’ve now completed the Lean formalization of its full derivation chain. Whole chain is accepted by Lean end to end.

I’m here because the work has reached the point where it needs to be inspected by people outside our own loop. Our reading of the repo is that the Lean proof now holds and my Claude Code confirms the same :) . I want to put it in front of the community so others can look at it directly. I’ll share the details shortly in a more appropriate channel.

Good to be here.
